biotools.summary: RNabel is a standalone software tool designed for the in-depth annotation of tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) spectra of modified ribonucleic acids (RNA). It efficiently analyzes large datasets to identify and localize various RNA modifications.
biotools.name: RNabel
